name: Unsaved active draft

patternBasis.rationale: Familiar desktop control and owner-defined behavior; specialized timeline manipulation is separately researched.

purpose: Enter only when the pending action would abandon an unsaved active video or playlist draft. Resolve this stage before any project decision. Discard remains deferred until successful continuation.

content.purpose: Identify which work would be abandoned.
content.text: Actual draft type and name, whether previously saved, and the pending action.

content.purpose: Explain deferred discard before confirmation.
content.text: For a saved draft, Discard requests restoration of its saved version. A never-saved draft is removed only when the pending action can proceed. Retain the current draft until all decisions and restoration/replacement succeed.

name: Timeline Add

patternBasis.rationale: An explicit review stage accommodates occurrence crop selection before the atomic addition.

purpose: Stage content, show target track and insertion time, optionally choose the source rectangle, then use Add once. Selection alone no longer inserts. Whole-source crop is the default for a file or named clip. Saved-video expansion preserves its existing description; incompatible destination track settings prevent insertion and identify the conflict. Cancel retains the original draft.

content.purpose: Retain current identity and operation state.

name: Selection Menu

patternBasis.rationale: Retain the existing selection-scoped command menu and add one contextual Ungroup choice; no separate group editor or persistent command family.

purpose: Identify All tracks range or Track N whole-object selection before presenting applicable operations. Range: Delete, Split, Save Clip. Whole objects: Delete and Reorder. Exactly one grouped occurrence: show Ungroup; enable only for full-frame group source rectangle, 100% group volume and mute off, with included parts and their composition settings representable on the destination track without overlap or picture/audio change. Explain unavailable group adjustments and placement/composition limits. Exactly one associated occurrence with changed temporal trim: Update Named Clip. Stop preview on entry and return to captured stopped/failure context on dismissal.

content.purpose: Retain current identity and operation state.
content.text: All tracks — Start, inclusive End and duration; or Track N — selected occurrence count and identities. Present commands for this scope. For a grouped occurrence, identify the group and its included extent. If its source rectangle is not full frame, volume is not 100%, or mute is on, show Ungroup unavailable and identify the applicable adjustment: its transfer to parts is not yet defined. Explain overlapping/multitrack placement or other composition settings that cannot be preserved on this track separately. The group, its settings and selection remain unchanged.
